steps.say: A right angle is a square corner. It measures 90°.
An acute angle is smaller than a right angle.
An obtuse angle is bigger than a right angle and smaller than a straight line.
A straight angle makes a straight line. It measures 180°.
A whole turn is 360°, so a quarter turn is 90°.

check.prompt: What kind of angle is this?

options.why: A straight angle makes a straight line.
An obtuse angle is bigger than a right angle. This angle is smaller.
A right angle is a square corner. This angle is smaller.

hints: Compare the angle with a square corner.
Is it smaller, the same, or bigger?
Look at how wide the arms open.
check.explanation: This angle is smaller than a right angle, so it is acute.

check.prompt: How many degrees are in a half turn?
hints: A half turn is half of a whole turn.
